definitions.explanation: An individual drop of rain. Used in both everyday descriptions of weather and in more literary or poetic contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{雨粒|あまつぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧きた。
⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{雨粒|あまつぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are raindrops on the window glass.

examples.japanese: {雨粒|あまつぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{葉|は}っぱ→葉っぱ：05388_happa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧キラキラ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{光|ひか}っていた→光る：01163_hikaru⟧。
examples.english: Raindrops were glistening on the leaves.

notes:
Composed of {雨|あま} (rain, combining form) + ⟦{粒|つぶ}→粒：03892_tsubu⟧ (grain, drop). Note that ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧ changes to {雨|あま} in compounds. The word ⟦{粒|つぶ}→粒：03892_tsubu⟧ is a versatile suffix for small round objects.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{雨粒|あまつぶ}: large raindrops
- {雨粒|あまつぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: raindrops fall
- {雨粒|あまつぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧: raindrops hit

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{大粒|おおつぶ}→大粒：15833_ootsubu⟧: large drop or grain (⟦{大粒|おおつぶ}→大粒：15833_ootsubu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧, heavy rain)
- ⟦{米粒|こめつぶ}→米粒：28256_kometsubu⟧: grain of rice
- ⟦{小粒|こつぶ}→小粒：16537_kotsubu⟧: small grain
